sentences.text: In the year 1849, a man named Jack is a prospector.
He is alone in the mountains.
Jack has a pickaxe and a pan.
Every day, he digs in the dirt.
One day, Jack finds a shiny rock.
He puts the gold in his bag.
But soon, Jack sees other miners.
He does not want to share.
He wants to find more gold before the others.
One night, Jack sees a fire.
He takes his gold and walks to the fire.
He is rich, but now he has friends too.
Jack learns that gold is good, but friends are better.
